messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
當球被投擲向上時，除了初始速度之外，它所受的加速度只取決於重力。  
在地球表面，重力加速度約為 \(9.8 \text{ m/s}^2\)，方向向下（即與投擲方向相反）。  

因此，無論球最初以多快的速度向上投擲（例如 5 m/s），它在空中會受到向下的加速度 \(9.8 \text{ m/s}^2\)。  
這個加速度在整個上升過程中保持不變，直到球到達最高點後開始下降。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？" They want to know what acceleration the ball will reach. But the ball thrown upward will experience gravitational acceleration downward of -9.8 m/s^2. The question might be incorrectly phrased: they might want to know the maximum height. But the user specifically asks about acceleration. So we should answer: The ball will accelerate downward at 9.8 m/s^2 (assuming Earth). The initial velocity is irrelevant to acceleration. So we can respond accordingly. There's no need to call the function.
